name: unswayed-demo-video
description: 55-second silent product demo for Unswayed, rendered with Remotion from the recorded runs in ../demo/data.js

scripts.studio: npm run data && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.render: npm run data && remotion render src/index.ts UnswayedDemo out/unswayed-demo.mp4 --codec=h264 --pixel-format=yuv420p
scripts.poster: npm run data && remotion still src/index.ts UnswayedDemo out/unswayed-poster.png --frame=1290
